references.text: Just as in Numbers 18:14, this verse explains that what is devoted to the Lord (cherem) belongs to the priests and is holy to the Lord.
These verses elaborate on the laws concerning cherem (what is banned/devoted), stating that everything devoted to the Lord is most holy and belongs to Him and the priests.
Ezekiel confirms that all that is devoted (cherem) in Israel shall belong to the priests, in accordance with the provision in Numbers 18:14.
Jericho was declared cherem (banned), and all silver, gold, and articles of bronze and iron were to come into the Lord's treasury.
Achan's sin shows the consequences of taking something that was cherem (devoted property), which belonged to the Lord.
